name: terrain-integrity
description: One screenshot: holes, odd surfaces and wrong colours. Visual judgment only: geometry invariants (T-junctions, topology) are proven by the Rust tests, not here.

hole_in_terrain.instructions: Is there a hole in the terrain surface in `screenshot`, a place where ground is missing and the background shows through?

hole_location.instructions: Where is the hole in the terrain surface in `screenshot`?

streaks_or_slivers.instructions: Are there thin diagonal streaks or slivers in `screenshot` that do not look like flat square block faces?

grass_on_top.instructions: Is green grass visible on the top surfaces of the terrain in `screenshot`?

placeholder_colour.instructions: Is any part of the terrain in `screenshot` bright magenta or purple?
